correctness.rationale: PASS: The Prüfer code has length n−2, and conditioning a designated vertex on degree d fixes exactly d−1 occurrences of its letter; remaining n−d−1 code symbols are iid uniform on the other n−1 vertices. Thus L|D=d=E_(n−1)(n−d−1)+1_{d=1}; the Stirling occupancy formula follows. Coupling successive box draws gives strict Q2<st...<st Q(n−1) and Q1>st Q2; star Q(n−1)>st Q1. For 3≤d≤n−2, Q1 has min2/max n−1, while Qd has min d≥3/max n−2, so tails cross. Symmetry and deterministic total degree give Cov(D,L)=0; the exact Δ_n expectation formula changes sign between n8 and n9, with exponential bound thereafter. Independent integer occupancy dynamics checked masses/order/means for all n3..30, complementing source Prüfer-tree enumeration n3..8. No inference beyond its supplied analytic proof.
